title: 新传批改神器 · AI Grading Assistant
tagline: AI grading for journalism grad-school exam essays
description: An independent product that grades journalism postgraduate entrance-exam essays. It decomposes 9 question types into 8 assessment dimensions, compares real grading runs against human scores to locate systematic bias, and iterates the prompt output from there — built, launched and marketed solo, now at 500+ users with early revenue.

title: Flatpack 3D
tagline: IKEA manuals, assembled step by step in 3D
description: The real IKEA manuals for the BILLY bookcase, LACK table and POÄNG chair, rebuilt in 3D in the order the drawings show. Every dowel, cam lock and nail goes where the page puts it, with the manual page, parts count and a step timeline alongside the scene.

title: My CD Shelf
description: A music player shaped like a shelf of CD jewel cases. Tap a case to open it and play, scroll to change discs, and pick tracks from the cover strip below.

title: Wander Atlas
tagline: A slow flight through Guilin and Prague
description: A low-poly travel atlas: choose a horizon and fly slowly through places shaped by river, stone and time — the karst mountains and mist of Guilin, or the river, rooftops and spires of Prague, with ambient sound.

title: EnterPro Creator Growth Program
tagline: Landing page for EnterPro's creator program
description: A campaign page inviting EnterPro builders to share their journey in exchange for free credits, “Outstanding Work” recognition, priority support and promotion across EnterPro's channels.
